goal: Read engineering sprint sync transcript, extract deliverables, create Jira backlog items, and update Sheets

steps.description: Extract structured engineering deliverables, assignees, and story points from the sprint sync transcript

tool_args.text:

steps.description: Create Jira backlog issues in bulk using the extracted deliverables from the transcript
steps.reasoning: Automatically create the required Jira backlog items and user stories for the sprint tasks extracted in step 1.

steps.description: Create a new Google Sheets spreadsheet to track sprint backlog items

steps.description: Append the newly created Jira issues and task details as rows into the Google Sheets tracker
steps.reasoning: Populate the tracking spreadsheet with the authoritative data from the generated Jira items.

steps.description: Post sprint sync executive summary and tracking links to the #sre-sprint Slack channel
